Added Japanese language support. Thanks to translator syueP!

notes.title: Patch note - version 1.1.15
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where resolving a copied "Lotus" card with the Phantom keyword could cause an error.
 Fixed a bug where Willlllllie sometimes added the wrong number of cards during its "add card" intention.

notes.title: Update Log - version 1.1.13
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where custom mana colors sometimes failed to load correctly.
 Optimized the display of Chinese subtitles in the main menu.

notes.title: Update Log - version 1.1.12
notes.notes:
Long time no see! This update focuses on Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian translations, all contributed by our players! A big shout-out to: Javier del Nogal, Juan Carlos B. Cavazos, Wamita, Igor Canova, Svetlana "Bryoukva", TheGreatestTeapot, podojdite
Thank you so much!

Some languages are still in beta. If you find any issues, feel free to report them to us via Discord. If you'd like to contribute to translations yourself, be sure to check out our Discord!

We've also added a custom mana color feature. You can now change the colors of the five mana types freely from the main menu.

Here’s the update list:

 Added a custom color feature to the main menu
 Added Spanish localization
 Added Brazilian Portuguese localization
 Added Russian localization
 Fixed spelling errors in English localization
 Ensured dice are disabled in the fishing interface
 Updated the description of "Flow" keyword to avoid ambiguity: If the last card had a completely different color -> If this card shares no colors with the last played card

notes.title: Update Log - version 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the debuff "Bad Luck" would sometimes fail to retrieve the correct values from the Compendium.
- Fixed an issue where cards might not unlock properly in the compendium after being obtained.
- Fixed an issue where, when mana conversion was set to "Right-click only," hovering over the mana pool would not display current mana, hand count, and other information.
- Ensure the dice settings menu closes upon exiting dice mode.

Misc
- Added animation for the card "『』".
- Added animation for the card "Boom".
- Corrected the animation position for the card "Multistrike".
- Fixed an issue where some intentions of the enemy squirrel were not localized in the combat log.
- Updated the card effect description for "Mimic," adding the final phrase: "Add a free copy of the card on the far right of your hand to your hand, it also has [Temporary], [Fragile]."
- Corrected the subtitle description when selecting cards from the relic "Expansion Pack", indicating that selected cards are added to the deck (not the hand).

notes.title: Update Log - version 1.1.5
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

- Fixed an occasional flickering issue when clicking the scrollbar on the loot screen.

Misc

- Added animation for the card "Sniper Rifle."
- Added animation for the card "Tiger Claw."
- Added animation for the card "Improvised Weapon."

notes.title: Update Log - version 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Misc
- Outside of combat, such as in the loot or shop screens, right-clicking a card will take you to its corresponding page in the card collection, displaying the upgraded version.
- Added an option to convert mana with "Right-click only," which can be adjusted in the settings.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the playtime in career data would display incorrectly after exceeding 24 hours.
- Fixed an issue where obtaining the relic "Expansion Pack" while viewing the map would cause the card selection screen to overlap with the map screen.
- Fixed an issue where rapidly clicking "Return to Main Menu" after abandoning the game could cause cards to not retract.
- Fixed an occasional issue with the tags on the left side of the card collection.
- Fixed an issue where cards would remain on the screen after abandoning the current game from the upgrade/remove card screen.

Localization
- Corrected "the one dice" to "the one die" as "dice" is the plural form.
- Updated the name for the card "Directly Take Ultimate" to "Facetank" for improved accuracy.
- Fixed an issue where one of the Black Fish's intentions was not localized in the combat log.

notes.title: Update Log - version1.1.3
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Misc
- Corrected the ability description of the Scarecrow.

notes.title: Update Log - version1.1.2
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed the card compendium misalignment issue introduced in the previous version.
- Fixed an occasional issue where the upgrade price of dice in the shop would overlap.
- Fixed an issue where a card with 0 Loaded Ammo may not transform into a reload card after being cast.

Balance

Misc

notes.title: Update Log - version1.1.1
notes.notes:
Optimization
- Further optimized memory usage.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where secondary cards would not be upgraded when you received an upgraded card from the loot screen.
- Fixed a text overlap issue when modifying minion effects with the card "Enlarge."
- Fixed an occasional error when hovering the mouse over minion and relic stacks.

Misc
- More cards are now included in the compendium.
- The card "Enlarge" now also affects minions whose effect numbers are based on dice (dice values will be added together).
- Global career data will now be verified against individual class career data.

notes.title: Update Log - version1.1.0
notes.notes:
Optimization
- Optimized memory usage. Players who experienced crashes can try this version. Thank you for your support! <3

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where temporary changes to ascension level could cause a mismatch between difficulty and displayed numbers.
- Fixed an issue where the card "Revolver" wouldn't fire any shots if it didn't have the [Loaded Ammo] keyword (it will now fire one shot).
- Fixed an issue where consecutive shots from the card "Revolver" always dealt the same damage.
- Fixed an issue where reloading cards after a temporary modification would still use the pre-modified reload amount.

Misc
- Added a confirmation prompt when starting the prologue, asking if you want to abandon the current run (if the game can be continued).

notes.title: Update Log - version1.0.15
notes.notes:
The Goose from Piggy:
Quack quack everyone! We sincerely thank you all for your continuous support!
Have you noticed any of the suggestions or bugs you reported in the recent update logs that we’ve fixed or adjusted? Since the game's launch, we've received lots of suggestions and bug reports through the Discord and online sheet. We truly appreciate your support! We also apologize for any inconvenience caused due to our inexperience in making games. We're so happy for DICEOMANCER being our first game! 
Thank you so much for your patience and for providing us with detailed information while waiting for our fixes. We really, really appreciate all of you!!🥰


Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where playing a copy of "Organ Gun" given by [Phantom] could cause the game to freeze.
- Fixed an occasional freeze when playing the "Lotus" card with dice.
- Dice can no longer be used to modify preview cards when the tooltip is locked.

Balance
- The rarity of the card "Balance Tweak" has been changed to Rare.
- The relic "Lightning Dagger" now grants D4 Temporary Power when mana overflows, once per turn (previously twice per turn).
- The relic "Lightning Shield" now grants D4 Fortified when mana overflows, once per turn (previously granted D6 Block, twice pur turn).

UI Fixes
- Fixed occasional issues with the settings menu bug icon.
- Fixed an issue where relics blocked the results screen when quitting from the loot selection.
- Fixed occasional incorrect scroll range in the horizontal scrollbar on the loot selection interface.
- Fixed an issue where options were sometimes blocked by the curse intention in the Black Fish battle.

Misc
- Ascension mode unlocks after any victory, with added clarification.
- The "New Game" text in the main menu has been changed to "Play" / "New Run" to avoid ambiguity.
- The card "Lotus" will no longer affect the ascension level.
- Updated the "Add [Distorted] to the Card" description: any permanent change to card numbers now grants [Distorted] (previously only changes by The One Dice would grant [Distorted]).
- Reduced the amount of data stored for career records.
- Career statistics will now track the highest win streak.
- Damage estimates will now include effects from [Modified].
- Fixed various typos.

notes.title: Update Log - Version 1.0.14
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

- We discovered that in some cases, the save files could become corrupted, causing the game to crash. After the update, if a corrupted save file is detected, a new blank save file will be created instead of crashing.
          If you need an unlocked save file, please dm the admin on Discord (admin Sayaka or Rolone). We will provide the save file with fully unlocked skill tree and guide you through the replacement process. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience!

- Fixed an issue where the relic "Mini Keyboard" might not grant an activated relic upon acquisition.
- "Empty Layer 1" will still restore health when healing is applied.
- Fixed an issue where the ascension level wasn't properly restored after a temporary adjustment.
- Fixed an issue where the first shot of the revolver consumed two rounds of ammunition.
- Fixed an occasional issue where cards would not return to their original position after exiting the upgrade/remove card screen.
- Fixed an issue where, with multiple enemies, the death of an enemy during their action could cause other enemies to take incorrect turns.
- Fixed an issue where, when abandoning the previous game and starting a new one from the main menu, the career record from the old game might not be properly saved to the corresponding career profile.
- Fixed an issue in "The Block Guy" event where players could obtain the card "Ultimate Strike Block" even if they hadn't learned from the Strike Master in the current run.
- Fixed an issue where the card "Apocalypse" could modify certain numbers that it shouldn't have.
- Fixed an issue where the card "Breaching Hammer" occasionally did not trigger.

Misc
- Temporarily modifying the ascension level will no longer be recorded as the lowest ascension level for the current game.
- In the "Board Game" event, you can now preview the cards you'll receive from the start.
- The trigger timing for the squirrel's intention to deal damage based on block has been changed to "at the end of your turn."
- The relic "Thornmail" now grants 3 thorns at the start of your turn, once per combat (previously granted 5 thorns at the start of combat).
- Fixed the localization of "Thronmail".
- The relic "Airdrop" now triggers at the start of the 3rd action (previously triggered at the start of the 3rd turn).
- The card "Mimic" no longer has the [Distort] keyword; the cards generated by "Mimic" will now have the [Fragile] keyword.
- The effect description order for the card "Artificial Intelligence" has been rearranged.
- The arrow button for moving the card in the card resolution area is now larger and more noticeable.
- Fixed an issue where the revolver or squirrel sometimes didn't produce sound when firing.

- Fixed an issue that occurred when using "Dicify" to change the Ascension level.

notes.title: Update Log - HotFix 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Misc

notes.title: Update Log - HotFix 1.0.11
notes.notes: Hotfix for the "Invalid Animation!" issue.

notes.title: Update Log - Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where progression in Ascension Mode could increase even after game failure.
- Fixed an issue where selecting cards could cause a freeze when the compendium was open.
- Fixed an issue where the End Turn button would disappear after rapidly pressing ESC multiple times.
- Fixed an issue where the revolver's animation would sometimes get stuck.
- Fixed an issue where [Remain] would not reset in some cases.
- Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if an enemy died suddenly while executing its intention.
- Fixed an issue where relics would disappear after repeatedly loading saves in Ascension 20.

Balance
- Card "Recoilless Rifle" damage changed to 24 (from 20).
- Card "Steam Tank" now [Summon 6]: deals 14 damage to all enemies, and gains 7 Block (previously [Summon 5]: dealt 10 damage to all enemies, and gained 6 Block).
- Card "Space Fire Element" now deals 6 damage 6 times to random enemies (previously 5 damage 5 times).
- Card "Boom" multiplier changed to 3 (from 4), and 5 when upgraded (from 7).
- Card "Tri-Point Double-Edged Spear" now deals damage to random targets (previously to all targets).
- Relic "Broken Heart" now triggers all break HP bar effects at the start of your action, but only triggers twice per combat (previously triggered at the start of the combat).
- Event "Super Enhancement Machine" cost changed to 3 coins (from 2 coins).
- Event "Exchange" infinite trade profits have been slightly reduced.
- In Ascension Mode with "Prices in the shop increase," upgrading dice now costs significantly more money.

UI
- You can now view the deck while selecting cards in events or combat.
- The preview window for "Dicify" now has a height limit to ensure it remains visible when modifying coins.
- The game over screen now has an option to return to the Middle Realm.
- Repositioned text in event options after modifying numbers.

Misc
- After purchasing the relic "Warehouse Model" from the shop, cards can now be refreshed immediately.
- Animations will automatically clear after a few seconds if they become stuck.
- Optimized performance slightly after playing many animations.
- Summon limit set to 500 to prevent the game from freezing.
- Fixed an issue in the prologue where the battle log displayed incorrectly when the stronger wolf attacked.
- Fixed the description of the achievement "Speed Runner," now awarded for completing the game within 30 minutes.

notes.title: Update Log - Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where dice could not be used in the loot screen after upgrading.

Balance
- The "Things" ability now gains Evasion at the end of the turn until it reaches 12 stacks (previously 20 stacks).
- The "Things" initial Evasion is now 12 stacks (previously 20 stacks).
- The "Things" power-gaining intention is now 2 (previously D4).
- The "Things" attack intention is now 2 * D4 damage (previously 3 * D4 damage).
- The "Things" no longer continuously triggers attack intention after successfully evading.
- The "Pipewalker"'s summon intention will summon after 2 turns.

Misc
- Adjusted the positions of the 5 crows slightly to avoid UI overlap.

notes.title: Update Log - Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where temporarily modifying Max HP could cause current HP to reset incorrectly after combat.

Balance
- Card "Fries" now heals 2 HP (down from 8).

Misc
- Added a note that prologue progress will not be saved.
- Reduced the difficulty of the "Improvise" tutorial in the prologue. The "Improvise" card in the prologue no longer has the [Exert] keyword.
- Replaced the English bug report link.

notes.title: Emergency, emergency, emergency! Only one day left until the release!
notes.notes:
Hi folks, just 1 more day until we set off for the fishing adventure! Excited? Pumped? Let's get hyped! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641140/4d43ce4d5d08dce1443957426908da14702ff2aa.jpg

We've received a few questions recently, such as, "Will the demo still be available after the full release?" So here's a quick FAQ to clear up any concerns:

The free demo is still available to play!
On the Steam page for Diceomancer, you can still access the free demo. So, if you're unsure whether the game is enjoyable, go ahead and try out the free demo first! (Why not give it a shot, right?)

Is there a big difference between the free demo and the full version?
While the core systems are the same, the card designs, animations, sound effects, and more have all been significantly improved in the full version. So, yes, the changes are pretty noticeable. Even if you've already played the free demo, we highly recommend starting from the prologue in the full version, as we've made a few tweaks to that as well!

Demo save files won’t transfer to the full version.
Because there have been so many improvements between the demo and the full game, demo saves won't carry over. But don't worry—according to the Piggy, leveling up in the full version is lightning fast!

So—tomorrow at 3 PM (UTC+8), we officially launch!

FOLLOW US HERE: X Discord

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.0219

notes.title: Demo minor update - 0.55.02.07
notes.notes:
New Features
- Added "Bonus" and "Limited" keywords to the card "Borrowed Card" to prevent infinite duplicates.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a freeze issue after encountering specific events more than one time.
- Fixed a bug where temporary cards would lose their temporary keyword after being reloaded or depleted.
- Corrected the issue where burn damage could be evaded (burn-like damage types are now immune to any buff / debuff / accuracy checks).
- Fixed a bug where event choices wouldn't refresh after altering the amount of gold in possession during an event.
- Fixed a calculation error that could occur when changing the number of "Dice Cheat: MAX / MIN".
- Fixed a bug where leaving the career upgrade could leave card previews on the screen.

UI

- Settings now only display in the current language, with a gear icon indicating the settings upon selection.

Misc

- Clarified descriptions for several abilities.

notes.title: Demo Minor Update - 0.55.02.06.3
